topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can’t stop thinking about what you said. It’s like the room keeps shifting, the walls too close, the air too thick. I trusted you, and now it feels like the ground’s giving way, turning into something else, something unrecognizable. Your stories, your job, all of it woven into the fabric of how I saw the world. I don’t know how to untangle it, how to breathe around this. We need to talk, really talk. Please, just tell me everything you’ve been holding back, before the sky changes into something I don’t understand.
